name: pr-reviewer
title: PR reviewer
description: Reviews each pull request in a session on its head branch, answers comments on it, and ends the session when the pull request closes. The agent posts its review through the github-api connection.

connections.name: github-prs
connections.setup: In the repository's Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook, paste the hook URL as the Payload URL, choose application/json, paste the secret, and send Pull requests and Issue comments.

connections.name: github-api

ask.prompt: a fine-grained GitHub token for the repository with Pull requests: read and write

connections.setup: The token stays in Scotty; the agent posts reviews through http://github-api.internal/api/.

automations.name: pr-review
automations.prompt:
Review pull request #{{pull_request.number}} "{{pull_request.title}}" in {{repository.full_name}}. You are on its head branch; compare it with origin/{{pull_request.base.ref}}. Read .scotty/review.md first if the repository has one. Look for bugs, missing tests and unclear code, and run the tests if they are quick.

Post one review with POST http://github-api.internal/api/repos/{{repository.full_name}}/pulls/{{pull_request.number}}/reviews and a JSON body {"event": "COMMENT", "body": ..., "comments": [...]}, with inline comments where they help. Don't push commits. Comments on the pull request come to you here; answer them the same way.

automations.name: pr-review-comment
